title: Restore missing sweep report modules
goal: Restore or replace the missing src/reports/markdown.js and src/reports/csv.js modules imported by both sweep runners. The current branch passes its self-test but npm run check and npm run sweep:fixture fail while loading the application command graph.
doneCriteria: Generated fixture reports contain no live client data.
The handoff records the repair commit and verification output.
constraints: Do not remove report generation merely to make imports pass.
Do not weaken self-tests or doctor checks.
Do not deploy or use live JobNimbus data during verification.
Do not include secrets or client PII in Git.

log.note: created after clean npm ci; both baseline commands failed with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND for src/reports/markdown.js

ROOT CAUSE: the modules existed on disk but .gitignore pattern 'reports/' (no leading slash) also matched src/reports/, so they were never trackable. Fixed by anchoring ignore patterns to repo root (/data/ /reports/ /work/) and committing both modules. Not removed to pass imports; report generation preserved intact. Pushed to workBranch via GitHub API (Claude git proxy is down this session).
reviewed in a clean detached worktree at 999a633; npm ci, npm run check, and npm run sweep:fixture passed; root reports remain ignored and source report modules are tracked

result.summary: Root cause was .gitignore shadowing src/reports/, not missing code. Anchored /data/ /reports/ /work/ to repo root and tracked both pure-formatter modules (no client data or secrets).
result.verification: npm run check exit 0; npm run sweep:fixture exit 0; git check-ignore confirms root reports/ still ignored while src/reports/*.js is now tracked; fixture sweep runs on static fixture data with no live API call.
